validation.method: Fresh SBCL loads gr8s/tests; assert fiveam:get-test for each suite, run fiveam:run!, exit nonzero on any failure
validation.scope: Pure Raft, loopback transport/TLS snapshots, file-WAL recovery and checkpoint tests, SIGKILL bootstrap children, source HA application tests

behavior: Intent becomes effective only through committed membership application
Unrelated config entries carry outstanding intents; promotion/removal clears the affected intent
Snapshot capture and restore preserve committed intent; legacy metadata absence means no intent
Intent validation precedes config mutation and snapshot application restore
Fresh WAL recovery restores intent but not volatile peer-applied evidence
limitations: Join does not yet admit requested voters as learners
Native slow64MiB transfer/interrupted-join acceptance remains open
Production durable voter startup remains unwired
